name: The Mark III: a robot that learns to water
summary: The next release's content, set by the CEO on 2026-09-09: a third robot that learns how to act by reinforcement. A reward says what a correct outcome is (a tile it made wet), it spends each day trying under a day's energy, and each night its weights move toward what earned more. The first version learns one job, watering, on purpose. Every action it takes goes through the same gateway and movement code as the player's, so it is watchable and replays exactly.
requirements: The reward is computed from what changed on the ground, never from the route walked
It decides once a second, one step or one verb at a time, and spends its own 600-unit day
What it is told before a decision is a data spec (tile, energy, a view of radius 2) that later robots can widen
Weights update only at the day turn, live in the actor's saved state, and a day replays to its autosave with them intact
Two runs on the same seed are identical; the seven-day learning curve rises on a fixed seed
Every watering looks and sounds like hers; it moves at the Mark I's pace; nothing changes without a cue
current_status: Every build item is on main, both suites green (2026-09-09). The night rule's baseline is fixed: a state-dependent baseline scaled by the meter left, rate 0.03, and a week of learning is now worth about a third more a day than no learning across 24 seeds, holding through day 20. In progress: the CEO's Q-99 ruling — a till action, a bare-soil channel and a 0.1 reward — with the demo's gate back on open ground, which is the test of his hypothesis. Then the tablet check. Q-98 (what it keeps when picked up) is still open.
